card.name: Linking words inside lists and exclusions
card.fires_on: Small linking words or dashes such as 'any', 'been', 'in', 'by', and '-' that sit mid-clause in lists, exclusions, or conditions. They come just before the next listed item or a qualifying phrase, in label text and patent guides.

modes.label: List dashes
modes.description: A dash bullet that starts the next item in a patent list of things that cannot be patented.
modes.example: What You Cannot Patent - Laws of nature (gravity, wind) - Physical phenomena (water, sand) <<->> Abstract ideas (a philosophy, mathematics)

modes.label: Linking words before a condition
modes.description: Words like 'any', 'in', or 'been' that introduce an ingredient, a patient group, or a negated condition.
modes.example: idermal necrolysis, Stevens-Johnson syndrome, erythema multiforme, urticaria, angioedema) or<< any>> of its ingredients, including ritonav
